posts.content_md: Just wondering -- would superconducting magnets effectively isolate lasers from vibration? Or would the beams pick up the vibration of the em field?

posts.author: glajciorz
posts.content_md:
I've heard a theory that an object suspended in magnetic field only will never settle down. But that's all I know.

There could be a problem with gas lasers as the plasma is susceptible to magnetic field.

Cooling would require some cryogenics and I would suspect thermal micro-movements.

Why not use air cushion for isolation instead ? It is being used for optical benches. I even sat on something like this - funny feeling when the table levels itself with an asymmetrical load.

greetings

Adam
